name: China — Shanghai
change_summary: First sealed Shanghai version: SI base 7,460–37,302, pension 16/8, medical 9/2, unemployment 0.5/0.5 to 31 December 2025, housing fund 2,690–37,302, minimum wage 2,740.

limits.authority: Labour Law art.41: at most three extended hours a day for special reasons
Labour Law art.41: at most 36 extended hours a month
Labour Law art.38: at least one rest day a week

wages.authority: 沪人社规〔2025〕10号 from 1 July 2025: CNY2,740 a month, CNY25 an hour (https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20250714/t0035_1434097.html). Item 4 excludes the employee’s statutory social insurance and housing fund from the monthly floor: the contract less the month’s employee pension, medical, unemployment and housing-fund shares must meet CNY2,740 (register CN-SH01). Overtime and the listed allowances are not in the contract basic the table reads.

work_rules.authority: Labour Law arts.36, 41, 44 (https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/xxgk2020/fdzdgknr/zcfg/fl/202011/t20201102_394625.html): eight-hour day; overtime normally at most one hour a day, three for special reasons, 36 a month; art.44 at least 150% for extended hours, 200% for rest-day work where no compensatory rest is arranged, 300% for statutory-holiday work. MOHRSS 人社部发〔2025〕2号 from 1 January 2025: 21.75 paid days a month and eight hours a day convert a monthly wage to a day and an hour (https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/SYrlzyhshbzb/laodongguanxi_/zcwj/202501/t20250101_533693.html). No national, Shanghai or Kunming text read for the register prescribes how a part month is prorated; the seed applies the same 21.75-day conversion: a joiner or leaver is paid the monthly wage ÷ 21.75 for each working day of the employment (statutory holidays on them counted), never above the month, and an unpaid day is deducted at the same day. That is a reading of the conversion, not an express proration rule (no register row). No national or Shanghai statute sets a night-work premium (register CN-N53).

encashment.authority: 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 arts.10–12 (职工带薪年休假条例 art.5): unused statutory days are paid at 300% of the day wage, which includes the normal pay already paid, so the leaver is owed the further 200%; the day wage is the monthly wage ÷ 21.75, the monthly wage being the average of the twelve months before the payment with this employer excluding overtime (fewer where employed shorter). A bonus is in that average (art.11 excludes only overtime), but the BONUS class does not mark WAGES (engine_defect: counts-toward matrix), so a paid bonus is not yet averaged in.

final_pay_deadlines.authority: 上海市企业工资支付办法 item 7 (沪人社规〔2026〕10号 from 1 August 2026, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20260731/t0035_1442850.html; the 2016 predecessor item is the same): on ending or lawfully terminating the contract the enterprise pays the wages in one sum when the exit formalities are completed, unless the parties lawfully agree otherwise; 劳部发〔1994〕489号 art.9 likewise at termination. The exit date stands for the formalities date, which no field records.

sources.instructions: Register: docs/inventory/china.md. Rates and bases are from the instruments named in each scheme’s authority; open items there refuse rather than default.

facts.label: Assigned work-injury rate (%)
facts.description: The employer-only work-injury rate the agency assigned: the industry class base rate (0.2/0.4/0.7/0.9/1.1/1.3/1.6/1.9%) after its float. It is an agency determination, never a default.

facts.label: Housing-fund rate each side (%)
facts.description: The unit selects one equal employer and worker rate, 5–7%; a lower rate needs an approved reduction.

facts.label: Supplementary housing-fund rate each side (%)
facts.description: Shanghai supplementary fund, 1–5% equal each side, only where the unit elected it; 0 where it did not.

exit_facts.label: Labour Contract Law ground
exit_facts.description: The LCL article the contract ended under. ART_36_EMPLOYER / ART_36_WORKER: a mutual ending proposed by the employer / the worker; ART_37 resignation; ART_38 resignation for the employer’s fault; ART_39 dismissal for fault; ART_40, ART_41; ART_44_1 fixed-term expiry; ART_44_2_3 retirement or death; ART_44_4_5 bankruptcy, revocation or closure; ART_87 an unlawful termination.

exit_facts.label: Worker refused a renewal on equal or better terms
Published prior-year monthly average wage
exit_facts.description: Owner rule 2026-09-28: LCL art.47 reads 直辖市、设区的市级人民政府公布的本地区上年度职工月平均工资 and 164号 当地上年职工平均工资; neither names the series or the changeover day. Default: the calendar year before the exit (literal 上年度), on Shanghai HRSS publishes one city figure, 本市全口径城镇单位就业人员平均工资: CNY12,434 a month for 2024 (https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgsgg_17341/20250918/t0035_1435637.html) and CNY12,577 for 2025 (https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgsgg_17341/20260818/t0035_1443203.html). A recorded value overrides the default; a figure published for a later year is a new sealed version.

exit_facts.label: Counted service months before 1 January 2008
exit_facts.description: LCL art.97 para.3: art.47 years count from 1 January 2008; service before it is compensated under the rules then in force. The completed months of counted service (this stint and any carried service) before 1 January 2008.

exit_facts.label: Compensation for pre-2008 service under the rules then in force
exit_facts.description: LCL art.97 para.3: the amount the rules in force before 1 January 2008 owe for that service on this ground, as the unit computed it (0 where they owe none, such as a fixed-term expiry). Not added on an art.87 unlawful termination, whose damages count every year from hire (Regulation art.25).

exit_facts.label: Service months carried from a transferring employer
exit_facts.description: Implementing Regulation art.10: service with the former employer the worker was moved from not by their own choice counts as service here, unless the former employer already paid 经济补偿 for it. The uncompensated months carried.

obligations.description: Register each employee for social insurance and declare the contribution base.
obligations.timing: Within 30 days of hire (Social Insurance Law art.58).

obligations.description: Withhold the worker share and remit both housing-fund shares.
obligations.timing: Within five days after payday (Regulation art.19).

obligations.description: Declare and remit the month’s withheld IIT for every payee.
obligations.timing: By the 15th of the following month (STA 2018 No.61).
